label: PORTFOLIO PROJECT · v1.2.3
tagline: A one-thumb commuter player for a Hong Kong radio archive.
problem: The station's web archive needs a hunt for each day's link and two hands to operate, which is painful on a crowded commute. It has no API and blocks cloud IPs.
solution: A personal-use PWA that discovers recordings on-device, then plays them in a one-handed vinyl-style player with auto-resume.
link_label: Personal-use PWA · built in 3 active days

features.title: On-device discovery
features.desc: Probes 14 days of audio URLs with metadata-only audio. No backend.

features.title: Vinyl player
features.desc: Spinning disc, drag-to-seek arc ring, ±30 / ±60s controls.

features.title: Smart date strip
features.desc: Lists only days with recordings; ticks episodes heard 95%+.

features.title: Auto-resume
features.desc: Remembers progress per episode and picks up where you left off.

features.title: Lock-screen control
features.desc: Media Session support for lock screen and headphones.

features.title: Today's shows
features.desc: HK-time schedule with a swipeable card stack and 'New' badges.

features.title: Adaptive layouts
features.desc: Phone, landscape two-column, 1.3x desktop and 1.5x iPad scaling.

features.title: Installable PWA
features.desc: Device splash screens, auto-update and iOS safe-area fixes.
